name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: Edge-anchored modal drawer sliding from top, right, bottom or left, built on reka-ui Dialog.
docs: Bind with v-model:open and pick an edge with side (top, right, bottom or left). Always render SheetTitle inside SheetContent so screen readers announce the drawer. Set hideClose when supplying a custom dismiss button.

<script setup lang="ts">
import { DialogRoot } from 'reka-ui'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type SheetProps = {
  /** Initial open state when uncontrolled. */
  defaultOpen?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<SheetProps>(), {
  defaultOpen: undefined,
})

const open = defineModel<boolean>('open')
</script>

<template>
  <DialogRoot v-model:open="open" :default-open="defaultOpen" modal v-bind="$attrs">
    <slot />
  </DialogRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Component } from 'vue'
import { DialogTrigger, type AsTag } from 'reka-ui'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type SheetTriggerProps = {
  as?: AsTag | Component
  asChild?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<SheetTriggerProps>(), {
  as: 'button',
  asChild: false,
})
</script>

<template>
  <DialogTrigger :as="as" :as-child="asChild" v-bind="$attrs">
    <slot />
  </DialogTrigger>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Component } from 'vue'
import { DialogClose, type AsTag } from 'reka-ui'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type SheetCloseProps = {
  as?: AsTag | Component
  asChild?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<SheetCloseProps>(), {
  as: 'button',
  asChild: false,
})
</script>

<template>
  <DialogClose :as="as" :as-child="asChild" v-bind="$attrs">
    <slot />
  </DialogClose>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { DialogTitle } from 'reka-ui'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <DialogTitle
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn('text-[17px] leading-snug font-semibold text-ink', attrs.class as ClassValue)"
  >
    <slot />
  </DialogTitle>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { DialogDescription } from 'reka-ui'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <DialogDescription
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn('text-[14px] leading-relaxed text-ink-muted', attrs.class as ClassValue)"
  >
    <slot />
  </DialogDescription>
</template>

export { default as Sheet } from './Sheet.vue'
export { default as SheetTrigger } from './SheetTrigger.vue'
export { default as SheetClose } from './SheetClose.vue'
export { default as SheetContent } from './SheetContent.vue'
export { default as SheetHeader } from './SheetHeader.vue'
export { default as SheetFooter } from './SheetFooter.vue'
export { default as SheetTitle } from './SheetTitle.vue'
export { default as SheetDescription } from './SheetDescription.vue'
export { sheetVariants } from './variants'

export type { SheetSide } from './variants'
export type { SheetProps } from './Sheet.vue'
export type { SheetTriggerProps } from './SheetTrigger.vue'
export type { SheetCloseProps } from './SheetClose.vue'
export type { SheetContentProps } from './SheetContent.vue'
